title: Why Buying a Home Feels Impossible

scenes.narration: Have you ever wondered why home prices feel so out of reach?

visual.text: Why Buying a Home Feels Impossible

scenes.narration: Since 1985, the median price of a new home in the US has skyrocketed.
We are talking about a total increase of 375%.
Today, a new home costs 4.8 times what it did in 1985.
The full story is on the channel.

visual.text: Data reveals the truth about housing

title: The Brutal Reality of Mortgage Rates

scenes.narration: Is the era of cheap money officially over for good?

visual.text: The Brutal Reality of Mortgage Rates

scenes.narration: In December 2020, mortgage rates hit a record low of 2.68%.
But the pendulum has swung back with force.
By October 2026, those rates climbed all the way to 7.33%.
The full story is on the channel.
Are your paychecks keeping up with the property market?
Since 1985, average hourly pay for workers has grown by 279%.
That sounds like progress, but it is not the full picture.
Property prices have surged 375% over that same timeline.
The full story is on the channel.
